facts.fact: The Gambia National Broadband Strategy 2020-2024, commissioned by the Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure in June 2020, covers 2020 to 2024 and sets targets of broadband coverage to more than 90% of the population by 2024, at least 75% of homes with affordable 5 Mbps download and upload speeds by 2022 and 4G coverage of at least 85% of the population by 2024; the document names no successor plan, and its own text refers to a review for the next five-year cycle.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure (MOICI)

note: No delivery fact: the document gives programme cost estimates and prospective funding sources but commits no money and reports no figures against the plan's targets.
